standard.description: The plugin jar alone, as documented for Paper.
The documented install: the mod plus the row's Fabric API release.

modmenu.description: The documented optional settings screen: the standard install plus the row's Mod Menu release.

missing-dependency.description: The mod without Fabric API: Loader must refuse before the game starts and name fabric-api.

bundled.description: The mod alone, the 1.2.0 documented install. Calibration and diagnosis only.

bundled-modmenu.description: The mod plus Mod Menu without Fabric API, the 10F configuration. Calibration only.

fapi-requirement-probe.purpose: Descriptor-only jar that declares fabric-api in depends (the 2026-10-25 Loader probe). It checks that the missing-dependency stage passes on a jar that declares the requirement.

paper/server/1.21.2.server_basis: PaperMC publishes no 1.21.2 server; Minecraft 1.21.2 players join Paper 1.21.3, the same-protocol (768) hotfix, so this row tests the plugin on Paper 1.21.3 with a protocol 768 client.
